company.name: Scripbox
company.shortDescription: Scripbox is a digital wealth manager
company.description:
Scripbox owns and operates an online investing platform that distributes mutual funds in India. Its platform allows investors to buy and sell equity, debt, and tax saving mutual funds. 

Sanjiv Singhal founded Scripbox in 2012. It has its headquarters in Bengaluru in India.
